statement: Let M, N be separable-predual II1 factors acting nondegenerately on one Hilbert space, with mutual strict g-near inclusions, where 0 < g < 1.74 · 10−13. Suppose that an amenable von Neumann subalgebra R ⊆ M ∩ N satisfies R′ ∩ M ⊆ R. There are faithful normal representations π : M → B(K) and ρ : N → B(K), a common unit vector Ω, and a number β < 50948 √ g such that: (i) both images are in standard tracial position with vector Ω; (ii) π|R = ρ|R, and the images have mutual strict β-near inclusions; (iii) for original contractions x ∈ M, y ∈ N, ∥π(x) − ρ(y)∥ ≤ β + ∥x − y∥; (iv) if eR is the projection onto π(R)Ω, then (π(M) ∪ {eR})′′ = (ρ(N) ∪ {eR})′′. The space K can be taken separable.
